record.original_question: Let G be a connected graph on n vertices with minimum degree delta, and let mu_1 >= ... >= mu_n be the Laplacian eigenvalues. Must the toughness satisfy t(G) >= mu_{n-1}/(mu_1 - delta)?

evidence.quote: Conjecture 8 (Haemers [80]). Let G be a connected graph on n vertex with minimum degree δ. Then t(G) ≥ μ_{n−1}/(μ_1 − δ).

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let G be a finite, simple, connected graph on n ≥ 2 vertices with minimum degree δ. The toughness of G is defined by
  t(G) = min { |S| / c(G − S) : S ⊆ V(G), c(G − S) ≥ 2 },
where c(H) denotes the number of connected components of a graph H, and the minimum is over all vertex subsets S whose removal disconnects G (with t(G) = +∞ for complete graphs). Let L(G) = D(G) − A(G) be the Laplacian matrix of G, where D(G) is the diagonal degree matrix and A(G) is the adjacency matrix, and let its eigenvalues be ordered as
  μ_1 ≥ μ_2 ≥ … ≥ μ_{n−1} ≥ μ_n = 0.

Prove or disprove: for every such connected non-complete graph G,
  t(G) ≥ μ_{n−1} / (μ_1 − δ).
artifact.status_search_result: The conjecture, attributed to Haemers, that t(G) ≥ μ_{n−1}/(μ_1 − δ) for connected graphs appears to still be open. The 2021 work of Gu and Haemers (published in Algebraic Combinatorics) provides "strong support" and proves weaker related bounds but does not establish the full conjecture, and no subsequent paper reporting a proof was found.

status_evidence.title: Graph toughness from Laplacian eigenvalues
status_evidence.snippet: present two tight lower bounds for t(G) in terms of the Laplacian eigenvalues and provide strong support for a conjecture for a better bound
status_evidence.claim: Conjecture is supported but not proven; remains open as of this work.

status_evidence.title: Toughness conjecture (Haemers)
status_evidence.snippet: Haemers' toughness conjecture concerning Laplacian eigenvalue bound for t(G).
status_evidence.claim: Conjecture stated by Haemers, not reported as solved.
